name: Keep a steady pulse
short_description: Maintain a repeated pulse for one minute within a small audible tempo variation.
self_assessment: I can keep a steady pulse for one minute without help or an external beat.
description: Maintain a repeated pulse for one minute within a small audible tempo variation. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Tap an even pulse for one minute
